Try for free — AI chat, image generation, and video creation in one app. Built on GPT-6, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Claude, Perplexity Sonar, Kimi, GLM & Muse Wonder. Generate AI images with Nano Banana, GPT Image & Grok Imagine, and AI videos with Seedance & Kling.

ALL-IN-ONE AI ASSISTANT

Meet Genie, your all-in-one AI assistant for work, study, and creativity. Chat with advanced AI models, ask questions, get ideas, solve problems, and turn your imagination into images and videos. Genie brings powerful AI tools together in a single, easy-to-use app.

AI CHAT & EVERYDAY PRODUCTIVITY

Use Genie to write emails, essays, stories, and social media captions. Brainstorm new ideas, get help with coding, learn new topics, translate text, and break down complex questions. Whether you're planning your day or working on a big project, Genie is ready to help.

Explore even more ways to get things done:
• Ask questions and explore new topics
• Write emails, drafts, and social media captions
• Brainstorm ideas and summarize text
• Get help with coding and debugging
• Translate text and explore languages
• Convert documents and PDF files
• Summarize YouTube videos
• Generate AI images and artwork
• Create AI videos and animations

EXPLORE AI MODELS

Discover GPT-6, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Claude, Perplexity Sonar, Kimi, GLM & Muse Wonder in one place. Explore different approaches to writing, reasoning, coding, and everyday questions. Switch between AI models to find the response and creative support that works for you.

AI IMAGE GENERATOR

Turn words into visuals with AI image generation. Use Nano Banana, GPT Image, and Grok Imagine to create artwork, illustrations, imaginative scenes, and social media content. Start with a simple prompt and bring your ideas to life. Experiment with styles, concepts, and creative directions.

AI VIDEO GENERATOR

Create AI videos using Seedance and Kling. Turn text prompts and creative ideas into engaging clips, or explore image-to-video creation. Make videos for inspiration, storytelling, social content, and personal projects without complicated editing tools.

ONE APP, MORE WAYS TO CREATE

From AI chat and brainstorming to image generation, video creation, document tools, and YouTube summaries, Genie puts your favorite creative and productivity features in one place. Whether you're a student, creator, professional, or simply curious about AI, discover new ways to learn, make, and explore.

Try Genie for free and see what you can create with AI.

INDEPENDENT AI APP DISCLAIMER

Genie integrates third-party AI technologies developed by independent providers. GPT and GPT Image are developed by OpenAI; Gemini and Nano Banana by Google; Grok and Grok Imagine by xAI; Claude by Anthropic; DeepSeek by DeepSeek; Perplexity Sonar by Perplexity AI; Kimi by Moonshot AI; GLM by Z.ai (Zhipu AI); Seedance by ByteDance; Kling by Kuaishou; and Muse Wonder by Meta. Genie does not own or develop these models and is not officially affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by their respective creators. All referenced model names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
